title: Even or Odd
problem: Given an integer on a single line of input, print "Even" if it is even, or "Odd" if it is odd.
starter_code:
# Read an integer.
# Print "Even" if it is even, or "Odd" if it is odd.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about how to tell whether a number divides evenly by 2.
hints.2: The modulo operator % gives you the remainder of a division - n % 2 tells you if n is even or odd.
hints.3: n = int(input()); print('Even' if n % 2 == 0 else 'Odd')

failure_explanation: Negative numbers can be even too (e.g. -8 is Even) - check n % 2 == 0 rather than assuming only positive numbers matter, and make sure the output text matches exactly: 'Even' or 'Odd' with that exact capitalization.
